months.note: 5월 중순~6월 중순 무렵 국내를 지나며, 번식지에서는 11월 하순에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 5월 중순에서 6월 중순 사이에 우리나라를 지나는 나그네새로, 바다에서 큰 무리를 지어 지내며 부산 앞바다, 낙동강 하류, 동해안 일대에서 관찰되었다. 슴새보다 몸이 다부지고 날개가 짧아 잠수를 잘하며, 수면에서 날개를 퍼덕여 물소리를 내며 날아오른다. 물고기와 두족류를 먹는다. 태즈메이니아섬, 바스 해협의 섬들, 오스트레일리아 동남 해안에서 땅속에 굴을 파고 무리 지어 번식하며, 흰 알 1개를 50일쯤 품는다.

art.subject: Short-tailed Shearwater (Ardenna tenuirostris), adult (sexes alike), as seen off Korean coasts on passage from mid-May to mid-June: entire plumage dark sooty brown; upperparts and tail blackish-brown; chin and throat slightly paler grey-brown; breast, belly and flanks grey-brown with paler feather edges; underwing dark with a variable, dull silvery-grey area on the coverts. Bill short and slender, blackish, with tube nostrils on top and a hooked tip; iris dark brown; legs and feet greyish.
art.pose: taking off from the sea surface with flapping wings, splashing the water
art.scene: Korean late-spring sea off the East Sea coast: open water with a large flock of shearwaters on and above the waves; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, flight side view from below: all-dark sooty-brown body, long narrow stiff wings with dull silvery-grey underwing coverts, short rounded tail with the feet just projecting
adult, side view swimming: rounded head, short slender dark bill with tube nostrils, slightly paler grey-brown chin and throat, blackish-brown back
art.build: Medium-sized seabird, about 35cm, smaller than a Black-tailed Gull, with a compact body, small rounded head and fairly steep forehead. Bill shorter than the head, thin, with tubular nostrils and a hooked tip. Legs set far back; the webbed feet project slightly beyond the short tail in flight. Wings long, narrow and stiff, held straight. Flies low over the waves with quick stiff wingbeats and long banking glides. Tail short and rounded. Rests in large rafts on the sea and dives well.
avoid: Do not paint white underparts or a pale, white-streaked face; that is Streaked Shearwater (Calonectris leucomelas).
Do not paint a pale pink bill or pink feet; that is Flesh-footed Shearwater.
Do not draw broad, bent, gull-like wings or slow flapping flight.
Do not paint bold white underwing panels; any pale area is dull and greyish.
